text.content:
They hang the Claws' lanterns, and collect.

Turf: Japantown, Jig-Jig Street
Known for: Hanging a Claw lantern outside every shop that pays, and collecting the money
Allies & rivals: Patron: the Tyger Claws. They hate the G4

Japantown bike kids. Every Claw boss on Jig-Jig Street started as a Lantern. The G4 paint over their lanterns faster than they can hang them.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
